lead.title: Lead organization
lead.description: It appears in the programme, answers for the commitments made and receives the committee's decision.
lead.single: You are submitting on behalf of this organization. To use another one, join it from your profile first.
lead.fieldHint: You belong to several organizations: choose the one leading this activity.

co.title: Co-organizers, partners and supporters
co.description: An activity may be run by several organizations. Add them here rather than in the presentation text: they will then be counted, filterable and credited in the programme.
co.pendingConfirmation: The organization named here will be invited to confirm. Until it does, the co-organization shows as “pending”.
co.searchHint: Search by full name or by acronym: both return the same record.
co.members: {count} registered member | {count} registered member | {count} registered members
co.emptyDescription: Check the spelling, or try the acronym. If the organization is not in the directory yet, it must first be created from the join screen.

roleHints.co_organizer: Takes part in designing and running the activity
roleHints.partner: Associated with the activity without leading it
